pit.name: ZuChiangMai PIT
pit.status: reviewed in-app preview; noindex; not deployed to zuchiangmai.app
pit.domainPolicy: inside zuchiangmai.app only; no separate PIT domain, CNAME or new registry number

selection.policy: All 29 existing public source records normalized; editorial prominence is separate from inclusion.
excludedMaterialClasses: private drives, raw inboxes/emails and attendee lists
new NOMAD/hard-drive material and private locations
child or bystander imagery without the required consent
Circle seat requests, empty profile walls and unapproved people profiles
4seas.org blank community frames and its stale calendar snapshot
source photo folders, original video bodies and large media files
upstream tip/payment and magnet scripts, trackers and runtime credentials
selection.capturePolicy: Near-duplicate audio/video records remain separate with captureGroup labels; no unproven deduplication.

rights.upstreamDeclaration: CC0-1.0 · no rights reserved · fork it
rights.codeAndOriginalSiteMaterial: Upstream repository carries CC0-1.0; follow the current all-doors licensing canon for new app code.
rights.thirdPartyMedia: Speakers, performers, photographers and other third parties retain their rights. The broad upstream CC0 wording is not treated as relicensing their voices, performances, likenesses or works.
rights.consentBasis: Reuse is limited to records and thumbnails already published in the public 4SeasPIT content pool. Public per-person permission receipts are not itemized; this prototype does not assert new consent or add new people/media.
rights.transcripts: Existing machine-generated public transcripts may contain recognition errors; quote with timestamps and link back to source.
rights.removalRequirement: Apply a local ID denylist before render/search; remove entry, poster, transcript and cached search hits immediately, and never let a later sync re-add it. External Drive/R2/GitHub copies require their own upstream removal handling.

runtime.audio: Direct HTML5 <audio src>; preload=none on the shelf and metadata only on open. Do not fetch MP3 bytes with JS: R2 supports ranges but did not return ACAO.
runtime.transcripts: Lazy-fetch canonical text only when a session opens; 4seaspit.com returned CORS *.
runtime.posters: Remote, lazy-loaded canonical thumbnails; on error use a neutral app-owned placeholder rather than inventing an image.
runtime.deepSearch: After an explicit spoken-word search of 3+ characters, lazy-load the 1.65 MB index together with the small source catalog. Map tuple positions through that fetched catalog's IDs; sourceCatalogIndex is build provenance, not a stable runtime key.
